_readme: Layer-1 university-spine expansion candidates (new canonical_entities/universities rows, not yet in the live spine). Shape mirrors scripts/expand-university-spine.ts's own NEW_INSTITUTIONS array so a future session with DB access can feed these in directly -- not added to that script this session per this session's own 'no production code' constraint. Every ROR id below was fetched live from api.ror.org (keyless, no guessing) on 2026-08-21 and is the top/exact-name hit for the institution, cross-checked against the institution's own domain in ROR's 'domains' field. None of these were written to the live database this session.

candidates.label: Kadir Has University
candidates.name: Kadir Has University
candidates.reason: ROR live-verified 2026-08-21 (exact top hit for 'Kadir Has University', domain khas.edu.tr matches ROR's own registered domain, established 1997). Genuinely missing from the spine -- confirmed via live read-only query (universities where country='Turkey' returned 12 rows, none named Kadir Has) before proposing this candidate. Directly relevant this session: this same university's high-school AI summer program (Kadir Has University AI High School Summer Academy) was independently researched and added to the opportunities pipeline (wave4/wave5 batches) without realizing at the time that the parent institution itself was absent from the university spine -- the two gaps are connected.

candidates.label: MEF University
candidates.name: MEF University
candidates.reason: ROR live-verified 2026-08-21 (exact top hit for 'MEF University', domain mef.edu.tr matches ROR's own registered domain, established 2012). Confirmed missing from the 12-row live Turkey spine before proposing. Same connection as Kadir Has: MEF's own high-school summer school (physics/engineering-focused, 20th year running, notable RSI-alumni track record) was independently researched this session for the opportunities pipeline before this spine gap was noticed.

candidates.label: Istanbul Bilgi University
candidates.name: Istanbul Bilgi University
candidates.reason: ROR live-verified 2026-08-21 (exact top hit for 'Istanbul Bilgi University', domain bilgi.edu.tr matches ROR's own registered domain, established 1996). Not to be confused with the already-in-spine 'Istanbul University' (a distinct, much older institution, ROR 03a5qrr21, founded 1453) -- checked both ROR records individually to avoid conflating them. Bilgi's own high-school summer school was already referenced in this repo's SUMMER_PROGRAMS_350_TRACKER.md (Wave 3, 'Istanbul Bilgi HS Summer School') as an existing opportunities row, but the parent university itself was never added to the university spine -- another case of the opportunity being captured without its organizing institution.

candidates.label: Marmara University
candidates.name: Marmara University
candidates.reason: ROR live-verified 2026-08-21 (exact top hit for 'Marmara University', domain marmara.edu.tr matches ROR's own registered domain, established 1883). One of Turkey's largest public universities by enrollment (per ROR/Wikipedia cross-reference, not independently re-verified this session) -- a genuine, large-population gap in Turkey's spine coverage, not a small or marginal institution.

not_pursued_this_pass.note: Additional well-known Turkish universities identified as likely spine gaps (Gazi University, Bahçeşehir University, TED University, Galatasaray University, Anadolu University) but NOT individually ROR-verified this session -- flagged by name only, from general knowledge, not confirmed against api.ror.org or cross-checked against the live spine. Do not treat these as verified candidates; a future pass should run the same live-DB-check + ROR-lookup discipline used for the four candidates above before proposing them.
